summary: Backend-only testing of Peer Benchmarking metric consistency vs Dashboard. All 6 tests passed. /api/benchmarking/my-company now reuses dashboard services and returns identical values to /api/dashboard/{social,governance,environment}-detail endpoints for ORG1.
critical_code_review_comments: peer_benchmarking_service.py cleanly reuses EmissionsMetricsService, EnergyMetricsService, WaterMetricsService, WasteMetricsService, social_detail_service, governance_detail_service - eliminates duplicate calc paths.

Response schema in router.py matches the metric shape produced by create_metric() - required OpenAI JSON schema fields (rawTextFound, reasoning, extractedValue, reportedUnit, normalizedValue, normalizedUnit, page) all populated for internal data.
Minor: OPENAI_API_KEY_PEER_BENCHMARKING and LLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY_PEER_BENCHMARKING gated behind /extract endpoint only, not touched by /my-company - good separation.
Minor: docstring in router.py still references 'unified ESGMetricsService' - update to 'PeerBenchmarkingService'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Peer benchmarking /api/benchmarking/my-company is verified consistent with dashboard endpoints. Dashboard endpoints require start_date & end_date query params (YYYY-MM-DD) or return 422. Use 2020-01-01 -> 2030-12-31 to get full-range values matching peer benchmarking defaults.
